lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਦਖਣੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: prabhaatee mahalaa 1 dakhanee ||
lines.translation: Prabhaatee, First Mehl, Dakhnee:

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੋਤਮੁ ਤਪਾ ਅਹਿਲਿਆ ਇਸਤ੍ਰੀ ਤਿਸੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਇੰਦ੍ਰੁ ਲੁਭਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: gotam tapaa ahiliaa isatree tis dekh i(n)dr lubhaaiaa ||
lines.translation: Ahalyaa was the wife of Gautam the seer. Seeing her, Indra was enticed.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਹਸ ਸਰੀਰ ਚਿਹਨ ਭਗ ਹੂਏ ਤਾ ਮਨਿ ਪਛੋਤਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: sahas sareer chihan bhag hooe taa man pachhotaaiaa ||1||
lines.translation: When he received a thousand marks of disgrace on his body, then he felt regret in his mind. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੋਈ ਜਾਣਿ ਨ ਭੂਲੈ ਭਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: koee jaan na bhoolai bhaaee ||
lines.translation: O Siblings of Destiny, no one knowingly makes mistakes.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਭੂਲੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਆਪਿ ਭੁਲਾਏ ਬੂਝੈ ਜਿਸੈ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: so bhoolai jis aap bhulaae boojhai jisai bujhaaee ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: He alone is mistaken, whom the Lord Himself makes so. He alone understands, whom the Lord causes to understand. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਨਿ ਹਰੀ ਚੰਦਿ ਪ੍ਰਿਥਮੀ ਪਤਿ ਰਾਜੈ ਕਾਗਦਿ ਕੀਮ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: tin haree cha(n)d prithamee pat raajai kaagad keem na paaee ||
lines.translation: Harichand, the king and ruler of his land, did not appreciate the value of his pre-ordained destiny.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਉਗਣੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਤ ਪੁੰਨ ਕਰੇ ਕਿਉ ਕਿਉ ਨੇਖਾਸਿ ਬਿਕਾਈ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: augan jaanai ta pu(n)n kare kiu kiu nekhaas bikaaee ||2||
lines.translation: If he had known that it was a mistake, he would not have made such a show of giving in charity, and he would not have been sold in the market. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਉ ਅਢਾਈ ਧਰਤੀ ਮਾਂਗੀ ਬਾਵਨ ਰੂਪਿ ਬਹਾਨੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: karau adhaaee dharatee maa(n)gee baavan roop bahaanai ||
lines.translation: The Lord took the form of a dwarf, and asked for some land.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਿਉ ਪਇਆਲਿ ਜਾਇ ਕਿਉ ਛਲੀਐ ਜੇ ਬਲਿ ਰੂਪੁ ਪਛਾਨੈ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: kiu paiaal jaai kiu chhaleeai je bal roop pachhaanai ||3||
lines.translation: If Bal the king has recognized Him, he would not have been deceived, and sent to the underworld. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਜਾ ਜਨਮੇਜਾ ਦੇ ਮਤਂੀ ਬਰਜਿ ਬਿਆਸਿ ਪੜੑਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: raajaa janamejaa de mata(n)ee baraj biaas paRhaaiaa ||
lines.translation: Vyaas taught and warned the king Janmayjaa not to do three things.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਨੑਿ ਕਰਿ ਜਗ ਅਠਾਰਹ ਘਾਏ ਕਿਰਤੁ ਨ ਚਲੈ ਚਲਾਇਆ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: tinhi kar jag athaarah ghaae kirat na chalai chalaaiaa ||4||
lines.translation: But he performed the sacred feast and killed eighteen Brahmins; the record of one's past deeds cannot be erased. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਣਤ ਨ ਗਣਂੀ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਪਛਾਣਾ ਬੋਲੀ ਭਾਇ ਸੁਭਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: ganat na gana(n)ee hukam pachhaanaa bolee bhaai subhaaee ||
lines.translation: I do not try to calculate the account; I accept the Hukam of God's Command. I speak with intuitive love and respect.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਵਰਤੈ ਤੁਧੈ ਸਲਾਹਂੀ ਸਭ ਤੇਰੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: jo kichh varatai tudhai salaaha(n)ee sabh teree vadiaaee ||5||
lines.translation: No matter what happens, I will praise the Lord. It is all Your Glorious Greatness, O Lord. ||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅਲਿਪਤੁ ਲੇਪੁ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਸਦਾ ਰਹੈ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh alipat lep kade na laagai sadaa rahai saranaaee ||
lines.translation: The Gurmukh remains detached; filth never attaches itself to him. He remains forever in God's Sanctuary.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਮੁਗਧੁ ਆਗੈ ਚੇਤੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਦੁਖਿ ਲਾਗੈ ਪਛੁਤਾਈ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: manamukh mugadh aagai chetai naahee dukh laagai pachhutaaee ||6||
lines.translation: The foolish self-willed manmukh does not think of the future; he is overtaken by pain, and then he regrets. ||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਾਏ ਕਰਤਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਏਹ ਰਚਨਾ ਰਚੀਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: aape kare karaae karataa jin eh rachanaa racheeai ||
lines.translation: The Creator who created this creation acts, and causes all to act.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਜੀਅਹੁ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੇ ਪੈ ਪਚੀਐ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: har abhimaan na jaaee jeeahu abhimaane pai pacheeai ||7||
lines.translation: O Lord, egotistical pride does not depart from the soul. Falling into egotistical pride, one is ruined. ||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਭੁਲਣ ਵਿਚਿ ਕੀਆ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਈ ਕਰਤਾ ਆਪਿ ਨ ਭੁਲੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhulan vich keeaa sabh koee karataa aap na bhulai ||
lines.translation: Everyone makes mistakes; only the Creator does not make mistakes.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਾ ਕੋ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਅਘੁਲੈ ॥੮॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: naanak sach naam nisataaraa ko gur parasaad aghulai ||8||4||
lines.translation: O Nanak, salvation comes through the True Name. By Guru's Grace, one is released. ||8||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: prabhaatee mahalaa 1 ||
lines.translation: Prabhaatee, First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਖਣਾ ਸੁਨਣਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: aakhanaa sunanaa naam adhaar ||
lines.translation: To chant and listen to the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is my Support.

lines.gurmukhi: ਧੰਧਾ ਛੁਟਕਿ ਗਇਆ ਵੇਕਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: dha(n)dhaa chhutak gaiaa vekaar ||
lines.translation: Worthless entanglements are ended and gone.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਦੂਜੈ ਪਤਿ ਖੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jiu manamukh doojai pat khoee ||
lines.translation: The self-willed manmukh, caught in duality, loses his honor.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਮੈ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: bin naavai mai avar na koee ||1||
lines.translation: Except for the Name, I have no other at all. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿ ਮਨ ਅੰਧੇ ਮੂਰਖ ਗਵਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: sun man a(n)dhe moorakh gavaar ||
lines.translation: Listen, O blind, foolish, idiotic mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਵਤ ਜਾਤ ਲਾਜ ਨਹੀ ਲਾਗੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਬੂਡੈ ਬਾਰੋ ਬਾਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: aavat jaat laaj nahee laagai bin gur boodai baaro baar ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Aren't you ashamed of your comings and goings in reincarnation? Without the Guru, you shall drown, over and over again. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਸੁ ਮਨ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਬਿਨਾਸੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: is man maaiaa mohi binaas ||
lines.translation: This mind is ruined by its attachment to Maya.

lines.gurmukhi: ਧੁਰਿ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਤਾਂ ਕਹੀਐ ਕਾਸੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: dhur hukam likhiaa taa(n) kaheeai kaas ||
lines.translation: The Command of the Primal Lord is pre-ordained. Before whom should I cry?

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਚੀਨੑੈ ਕੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh viralaa cheenhai koee ||
lines.translation: Only a few, as Gurmukh, understand this.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਹੂਨਾ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naam bihoonaa mukat na hoee ||2||
lines.translation: Without the Naam, no one is liberated. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਡੋਲੈ ਲਖ ਚਉਰਾਸੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhram bhram dolai lakh chauraasee ||
lines.translation: People wander lost, staggering and stumbling through 8.4 million incarnations.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਬੂਝੇ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਫਾਸੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: bin gur boojhe jam kee phaasee ||
lines.translation: Without knowing the Guru, they cannot escape the noose of Death.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੂਆ ਖਿਨੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਊਭਿ ਪਇਆਲਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ihu manooaa khin khin oobh paiaal ||
lines.translation: This mind, from one moment to the next, goes from the heavens to the underworld.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਛੂਟੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮੑਾਲਿ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh chhootai naam samhaal ||3||
lines.translation: The Gurmukh contemplates the Naam, and is released. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਸਦੇ ਢਿਲ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: aape sade dhil na hoi ||
lines.translation: When God sends His Summons, there is no time to delay.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਬਦਿ ਮਰੈ ਸਹਿਲਾ ਜੀਵੈ ਸੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabad marai sahilaa jeevai soi ||
lines.translation: When one dies in the Word of the Shabad, he lives in peace.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਸੋਝੀ ਕਿਸੈ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: bin gur sojhee kisai na hoi ||
lines.translation: Without the Guru, no one understands.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਕਰੈ ਕਰਾਵੈ ਸੋਇ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: aape karai karaavai soi ||4||
lines.translation: The Lord Himself acts, and inspires all to act. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਝਗੜੁ ਚੁਕਾਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jhagaR chukaavai har gun gaavai ||
lines.translation: Inner conflict comes to an end, singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: pooraa satigur sahaj samaavai ||
lines.translation: Through the Perfect True Guru, one is intuitively absorbed into the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਡੋਲਤ ਤਉ ਠਹਰਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: ihu man dolat tau thaharaavai ||
lines.translation: This wobbling, unsteady mind is stabilized,

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਕਰਣੀ ਕਰਿ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵੈ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: sach karanee kar kaar kamaavai ||5||
lines.translation: and one lives the lifestyle of true actions. ||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਜੂਠਾ ਕਿਉ ਸੁਚਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)tar joothaa kiu such hoi ||
lines.translation: If someone is false within his own self, then how can he be pure?

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਬਦੀ ਧੋਵੈ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabadee dhovai viralaa koi ||
lines.translation: How rare are those who wash with the Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕੋਈ ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh koee sach kamaavai ||
lines.translation: How rare are those who, as Gurmukh, live the Truth.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਵਣੁ ਜਾਣਾ ਠਾਕਿ ਰਹਾਵੈ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: aavan jaanaa thaak rahaavai ||6||
lines.translation: Their comings and goings in reincarnation are over and done. ||6||
